title: About Vitaly Chait

title: PolyGains by Vitaly Chait
text: POLYGAINS / CASE STUDY Making prediction market activity easier to inspect. PolyGains brings market trades, wallet activity, unusual flow alerts, and trader analytics into a working public terminal. As a co-developer, I work on its backend data streaming and quantitative analysis. My role Engineering and analytics Domain Prediction markets Product Live terminal and analytics views Open PolyGains Explore analytics Live PolyGains terminal captured in October 2026. Figures and market activity change over time. THE PROBLEM Raw activity is hard to follow. Prediction market activity spans markets, matched orders, and wallet addresses. Looking at one trade in isolation gives little context about the market or the trader behind it. The product helps visitors move from an unusual event to the related market and wallet activity. MY CONTRIBUTION From data to inspection. I built data streaming pipelines for transaction ingestion, order flow, and wallet clustering, then helped surface that information in interfaces people can explore. PolyGains brings those strands together as alerts, market summaries, and trader views. PRODUCT FLOW What the public product shows Market activity moves through indexing and analysis before it reaches the terminal. 01 Market activity Matched orders and wallet transactions on Polymarket. 02 Index and organize Bring activity into market, trade, and wallet views. 03 Flag patterns Surface unusual trades and related signals for review. 04 Explore Inspect alerts, analytics, and trader context in the terminal. DESIGN DECISIONS Keep the trail visible. The terminal presents a scan, discover, and follow path. Filters narrow the alert table by market category, while lookup links make individual activity inspectable. The analytics dashboard separates market overview, detailed charts, and advanced views. WORKING TODAY A public, usable product. Visitors can browse the live alerts table, inspect market analytics, and open trader views. The dashboard also links to a Metabase workspace. Market analytics view captured in October 2026. The displayed market and figures are a snapshot. See the product in context. title: Vitaly Chait Research
text: RESEARCH Evaluation, evidence, and real-world data. My research focuses on problems where system behavior changes over time, including multi-turn language-model safety, financial signals, and market activity. LLM SAFETY Dynamic multi-turn youth-safeguarding benchmark This research examines how conversational risks for young people can evolve across multiple turns. The benchmark is designed to test contextual guardrails beyond single-prompt safety checks. Evaluation workflow Design a multi-turn scenario Run the conversation Review contextual risks Compare guardrail behavior The evaluation traces how risk changes across a conversation. QUANTITATIVE ANALYTICS Multi-asset meta-labeling pipeline During summer 2026, I researched a multi-asset portfolio meta-labeling pipeline in collaboration with State Street Global Advisors through Brandeis School of Business and Economics. The work explored portfolio data, time series, and risk modeling.
